{"like":["Enjoys classic slapstick animation like Bugs Bunny and Road Runner in Animaniacs.","Values humor without raunchy content, as seen in The Middle’s family-friendly comedy.","Prefers uplifting, light-hearted films such as The Hobbit: Battle of the Five Armies.","Appreciates comedic storytelling that encourages reflection, exemplified by Me Again and Brother White.","Enjoys nostalgic sci‑fi series with addictive pacing, like Lost in Space’s 1960s vibe."],"dislike":["Dislikes films with depressing tones and abrupt endings, such as The Lunchbox.","Avoids movies with poorly developed characters and weak narratives, like One Hit From Home.","Finds B‑movie quality unappealing, especially in the 8‑Film British Cinema Collection.”,"
